completeness.listVsSingleGet: verified identical — list payloads are not truncated
completeness.rawVersionHistory: 11.9 MB, not committed; history-index.json summarises it and it is reproducible with GET /assistant/{id}/version?limit=100

versionEndpoints.correction: An earlier pass reported 'tools have no version history'. That was wrong: it tested /tool/{id}/version (singular), which 404s. The working path is /versions (plural).
versionEndpoints.GET /assistant/{id}/version: 200 — 444 auto-snapshots, full config under a `data` key
versionEndpoints.GET /assistant/{id}/versions: 200 — 33 NAMED versions (v1/v2/v3) with configHash, parentVersion and createdBy; a different and smaller set
versionEndpoints.note: The two assistant endpoints are different systems, not aliases. Both are captured.

toolViewCoverage.assertion: Every scalar value in every raw tool payload appears in at least one readable view (tool-prose, tool-state or tools-index). Currently 0 unrepresented.
exclusions: function.parameters.type — the constant "object" on all 20 tools
credential header values, which are redacted by design
toolViewCoverage.history: An earlier version of these views omitted four things that only the raw JSON carried: static body fields (tool.parameters), variableExtractionPlan, tool metadata and function.strict — plus non-credential header values. The raw JSON was always complete; the readable layer was not. This assertion exists so that cannot recur silently.

npcSplit.note: Vapi has no folder concept; the split is by name prefix and corroborated by squad membership and phone-number naming. Only the NPC set is in scope for migration — see ../npc-services/clone-plan.json.

source.method: GET only — nothing in this org was modified to produce it

assistantDeepCapture.prompts: prompts/<sha16>.md — every distinct system-prompt block across current state AND all version history, stored once, as readable text.
assistantDeepCapture.history: history/<assistant>.json — every version's full configuration, verbatim, with system prompts replaced by promptRef into the store.
assistantDeepCapture.lossless: Verified: all 444 versions rehydrate to a byte-identical match against the raw API payload, and every live prompt block is present unaltered.
assistantDeepCapture.state: state/<assistant>.md — one readable card per assistant covering model, voice, transcriber, server, tools, messages, behaviour flags, prompt refs and call counts.
assistantDeepCapture.comparison: COMPARISON.md — the 15 NPC assistants side by side, plus a tool matrix.
assistantDeepCapture.callVolume: call-volume.json — COUNTS ONLY. No transcript, recording, phone number or any other call content was requested or stored.

toolDeepCapture.prose: tool-prose/<tool>.md — the function description, every parameter description, the spoken request-start/complete/failed messages and any transfer destination. This is everything an LLM reads when deciding whether and how to call the tool. Verified verbatim against the JSON.
toolDeepCapture.state: tool-state/<tool>.md — server URL/timeout/header names, async flag, function signature, messages and the list of assistants that use it.
toolDeepCapture.comparison: TOOLS-COMPARISON.md — all 20 side by side, an assistant×tool matrix, and the orphans and dangling references.

squadPhoneWorkflowCapture.squad-state: one card per squad: every member, every override, and the inline handoff tool expanded with its destinations, the condition each is chosen on, and the variables it extracts.
squadPhoneWorkflowCapture.phone-state: one card per number: what it routes to, sipUri, fallbackDestination, smsEnabled, server, and whether it can be carried across at all.
squadPhoneWorkflowCapture.workflow-state: the workflow as a mermaid graph plus every conversation-node prompt, first message, tool node and edge condition, all verbatim.
squadPhoneWorkflowCapture.versionHistory: none exists — /version and /versions both 404 for squad, phone-number and workflow. ?version=v1 returns 200 but is byte-identical to the current record, so the parameter is ignored rather than serving history.

workflowIsAnUncustomisedSample.referencedBy: nothing — no phone number, assistant or squad points at it
workflowIsAnUncustomisedSample.conclusion: a Vapi health-clinic sample template with an NPC name. Decide what it is for before migrating it; as it stands it carries no NPC content and no traffic.
